messages.author: da77893170c854f8
messages.subject: Side by side plots
parts: Looking to plot two gl.pcoa.plot plots side by side - similar to what can be done using ggplot's facet_wrap/grid to show comparisons. Is there a way you can do this with dartR plots?

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: Side by side plots
parts:
Hi,

Below is one option.

Cheers,
Luis 

# install developing version of dartR
devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR@dev")
library(dartR)
# install patchwork package
# install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)
t1 <- platypus.gl
t1 <- gl.filter.callrate(t1,threshold = 1)
pca1 <- gl.pcoa(t1)
p1 <- gl.pcoa.plot(pca1,t1)

t2 <- bandicoot.gl
pca2 <- gl.pcoa(t2)
p2 <- gl.pcoa.plot(pca2,t2)

# plotting using patchwork package
# vertical plot
p1 / p2
# horizontal plot
p1 + p2

This doesn't seem to work for me. If I run:

I get the plot displaying. But if I try to write it to an object:

I just get a NULL object.  It doesn't save the plot to p1

Any thoughts?

Cheers,

Renee

messages.subject: Re: Side by side plots
parts:
Hi Renee,

Can you try installing the developing version of dartR.base as shown below. Note that if you have a genlight/dartR object in your environment, Rstudio will automatically load the library that created that object and the installation will fail. To avoid this, it would be better if you install the developing version of dartR in an Rstudio session with an empty Environment.

Cheers,
Luis  

# install developing version of dartR.base
devtools::install_github("green-striped-gecko/dartR.base@dev")
library(dartR.base)

# install patchwork package
# install.packages("patchwork")
library(patchwork)
t1 <- platypus.gl
t1 <- gl.filter.callrate(t1,threshold = 1)

p2 <- gl.pcoa.plot(pca2,t2)

# plotting using patchwork package
# vertical plot
p1 / p2
# horizontal plot
p1 + p2
